FiberQ 1.6.0: tests 30 and 31, the language follows QGIS

FiberQ 1.6.0, plugin folder git tree cf7ce22b9999 · QGIS 4.2.3 · 7 November 2026

Before a release, FiberQ goes through a written re-check list. Each step says what to click and what you should see. This page is tests 30 and 31 of the 1.6.0 list: FiberQ speaks the language QGIS speaks. Test 30 starts QGIS three times: as usual, on a computer set to Serbian, and as usual again. Test 31 shows the same a second way, with qgis --lang sr.

Each start was replayed click by click in the real QGIS 4.2.3 desktop application: the official QGIS Docker image, on a virtual screen, with no network. FiberQ was installed into a fresh QGIS profile for every start, as Plugins → Install from ZIP leaves it. Every check compares what QGIS showed with the words the list expects. Click a screenshot to see it full size.
